note: Sunstone's Custom (quoted) tier as its own profile, so tools that read only the top-level floors see it. The online profile is sunstone_circuits.json. stackups_note: The 6, 8, 10 and 12 L standard FR-4 constructions of sunstone_circuits.json (read 2026-10-17 from the construction-sheet PDFs; every sheet is still linked from the layer-stackup page on 2026-10-23). The page: 'ASC Sunstone has published our set of standard multilayer constructions for FR-4 designs'; a custom tier may also quote a custom stack-up. Stackup selector data (89 rows: copper weight 1/2/3 oz finished x layers x thickness) is embedded in the page's Next.js payload, readable with curl (no JS needed); each row links a construction-sheet PDF on cms.sunstone.com. One stackup per unique construction sheet (sheet code, e.g. L04-062-1ozHoz = 1 oz inner / half-oz outer foil; 1oz1oz; 2oz2oz). Every layer thickness is printed in both in and mm; thickness_mm uses the printed mm. copper_outer_oz is the BASE outer foil weight as printed ('0.5 oz foil plated to approximate* thickness 0.0017'); the page's selector calls these 1 / 2 / 3 oz FINISHED weights (site_copper_weight-s). er: 77 sheets print a sheet-level footnote 'Average Dielectric Constant 4.3 @ 1 GHz / 4.8 @ 1 MHz' (er = 4.3 at 1 GHz used on every dielectric); 8 newer sheets print 'Avg Dk 4.5' / 'Avg DC 4.5' / 'Avg Dielectric Constant 4.5' on each dielectric (er = 4.5). Each layer's er-s says which. The page says these are FR-4 constructions; no laminate brand. None is stated as impedance-controlled. Site data issues: the '2 Oz' 6-layer rows (all 7 thicknesses) link to L06-xxx-1ozHoz sheets identical in numbers to the '1 Oz' ones (sheets with Avg Dk 4.5 instead of the 4.3 footnote) - so no 6-layer 1oz/1oz sheet is published. For the 7 L06-xxx-1ozHoz codes the newer variant (per-layer Avg Dk 4.5, correct printed total) is used; the older variant linked from the '1 Oz' rows has identical layer thicknesses but prints the 4.3 @ 1 GHz footnote and a total short by 0.0014 in (e.g. 0.0608 vs 0.0622).
